description: List the company skill library: each skill's id, name, category, one-line description, length and where it came from, without its text. Read the descriptions to find the skill that covers a task, then load its text with anyforge_get_skill. Call it before anyforge_create_skill so you extend or skip a rule the library already has instead of adding a near-duplicate. `q` narrows by name, category or description. Requires `read` scope.

q.description: Text to look for in a skill's name, category or description.

name: anyforge_list_skills
title: List skills
